latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Video Editor Music Sync.

- Instantly syncs video cuts to music beats or beat drops via AI-powered editing.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WAV uploads up to 500MB for seamless video and music integration.
- Automatic cloud-based processing—no manual editing or software required.
- Fast turnaround: get beat-synced videos back in 30–60 seconds.
- Designed for easy use by content creators and social media editors.
- Includes robust session management, error handling, and credit system with free trial.
